name: Bauhaus
summary: Dessau-era printed matter: cream stock, black, the three primaries, a geometric sans set lowercase, circle / square / triangle as structure.
lineage: Bauhaus Dessau print shop (Herbert Bayer, László Moholy-Nagy, Joost Schmidt), 1925-32; Bayer's universal lowercase alphabet.

motion.grammar: build: shapes and type slide in from the left as if set on the press, .5 s, 180 ms stagger

frame: a key of the three shapes with the page number, bottom left
